definitions.gloss: ballot counting; vote counting; opening of ballots
definitions.explanation: The process of opening and counting votes after an election.

examples.japanese: {開票|かいひょう}が{始|はじ}まった。
{開票|かいひょう}{速報|そくほう}をテレビで{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: I was watching the vote-counting updates on TV.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}まで{開票|かいひょう}{作業|さぎょう}が{続|つづ}き、ようやく{結果|けっか}が{確定|かくてい}した。
examples.english: The ballot-counting work continued until late at night, and the results were finally confirmed.

notes: Common collocations: {開票|かいひょう}する (to count ballots), {開票|かいひょう}{速報|そくほう} (vote-counting flash report), {開票|かいひょう}{作業|さぎょう} (ballot-counting work), {開票|かいひょう}{結果|けっか} (counting results). The character {開|かい} here means "to open" (the ballot box), and {票|ひょう} means "ballot." Compare with {投票|とうひょう} (casting a vote) and {得票|とくひょう} (votes received).
